canonical_example.translation: This tennis player has one of the strongest returns in the history of the game.

canonical_example.translation: Lastly, you have to take the freight charges away from the profits.

canonical_example.translation: The fact that his work is unknown to the general public doesn't minimize its value.

canonical_example.translation: We shouldn't play down the importance of isolated cases like this one.

canonical_example.translation: Only time can prove you that you're wrong.
